title: Karl Data Narrative: Home health aides earn a median of roughly $16 an hour
author: MTCSTW Training Pack
text:
[Statistic: Home health aides earn a median of roughly $16 an hour]
[Source: Bureau of Labor Statistics (approximate)]

They bathe and feed our parents. They're among the fastest-growing jobs and among the lowest paid. Care work is real work.

title: Karl Data Narrative: Most home care workers are women, and many are women of colo
author: MTCSTW Training Pack
text:
[Statistic: Most home care workers are women, and many are women of color]
[Source: PHI, U.S. Home Care Workers report]

The work was undervalued because of who did it. Home care workers were left out of federal wage protections until 2015. Pay care workers what they're worth.

title: Karl Data Narrative: Home care workers were only covered by federal minimum wage
author: MTCSTW Training Pack
text:
[Statistic: Home care workers were only covered by federal minimum wage and overtime rules starting in 2015]
[Source: U.S. Department of Labor]

For decades, the people caring for the elderly and disabled weren't guaranteed minimum wage. The exclusion was rooted in racism. Organizing ended it.

title: Karl Data Narrative: U.S. corporate profits as a share of GDP reached historic hi
author: MTCSTW Training Pack
text:
[Statistic: U.S. corporate profits as a share of GDP reached historic highs in recent years]
[Source: Bureau of Economic Analysis (approximate)]

Profits are taking a bigger slice of the economy than in generations. That slice came out of workers' share.

title: Karl Data Narrative: The labor share of income has declined since the early 2000s
author: MTCSTW Training Pack
text:
[Statistic: The labor share of income has declined since the early 2000s]
[Source: Bureau of Labor Statistics / BEA (approximate)]

Less of every dollar the economy produces goes to the people who work. More goes to owners. That's the trend behind your stagnant paycheck.

title: Karl Data Narrative: The U.S. spends a smaller share of GDP on early childhood ca
author: MTCSTW Training Pack
text:
[Statistic: The U.S. spends a smaller share of GDP on early childhood care than most wealthy countries]
[Source: OECD Family Database]

We fund K-12 but leave the most important years to parents' wallets. Other countries made a different choice.

title: Karl Data Narrative: Life expectancy in parts of Appalachia and the Deep South la
author: MTCSTW Training Pack
text:
[Statistic: Life expectancy in parts of Appalachia and the Deep South lags the national average by years]
[Source: Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation (approximate)]

Where you're born in America can cost you a decade of life. Poverty, pollution and closed hospitals shorten lives.

title: Karl Data Narrative: Native American life expectancy is several years below the n
author: MTCSTW Training Pack
text:
[Statistic: Native American life expectancy is several years below the national average]
[Source: CDC / Indian Health Service]

Broken treaties, underfunded health services, stolen land. The numbers are the receipts.

title: Karl Data Narrative: The Indian Health Service is funded far below estimated need
author: MTCSTW Training Pack
text:
[Statistic: The Indian Health Service is funded far below estimated need]
[Source: National Indian Health Board / IHS (approximate)]

Treaty obligations promised healthcare. Congress underfunds it year after year. A promise broken in every budget.

title: Karl Data Narrative: Much of Puerto Rico went without reliable power for months a
author: MTCSTW Training Pack
text:
[Statistic: Much of Puerto Rico went without reliable power for months after Hurricane Maria in 2017]
[Source: FEMA / news reports (approximate)]

U.S. citizens left in the dark for months. Thousands died in the aftermath. Colonial neglect has a death toll.

title: Karl Data Narrative: A Harvard-led study estimated about 4,600 excess deaths in P
author: MTCSTW Training Pack
text:
[Statistic: A Harvard-led study estimated about 4,600 excess deaths in Puerto Rico after Hurricane Maria]
[Source: Kishore et al., New England Journal of Medicine (2018, estimate)]

The official count started at 64. Researchers found thousands. When the dead are poor and far from power, they go uncounted.

title: Karl Data Narrative: The minimum wage for tipped workers is the full state minimu
author: MTCSTW Training Pack
text:
[Statistic: The minimum wage for tipped workers is the full state minimum in states including California, Washington and Minnesota]
[Source: U.S. Department of Labor, state laws]

Restaurants in those states still thrive. Servers still get tips. Ending the subminimum wage works.

title: Karl Data Narrative: Child labor laws were loosened in several states starting in
author: MTCSTW Training Pack
text:
[Statistic: Child labor laws were loosened in several states starting in 2022]
[Source: Economic Policy Institute tracker]

At the same time violations surged, some legislatures made it easier to put kids on longer shifts in dangerous jobs. That's a choice to sacrifice children for cheap labor.

title: Karl Data Narrative: Workers' compensation benefits have been cut in many states
author: MTCSTW Training Pack
text:
[Statistic: Workers' compensation benefits have been cut in many states since the early 2000s]
[Source: ProPublica / NPR investigation (2015)]

Get hurt on the job, and many states pay less than they used to. The bargain was: give up your right to sue, get care. Bosses kept the first half.

title: Karl Data Narrative: About 1 in 3 U.S. adults has a criminal record
author: MTCSTW Training Pack
text:
[Statistic: About 1 in 3 U.S. adults has a criminal record]
[Source: Bureau of Justice Statistics / Brennan Center (approximate)]

A record follows you to every job application. Punishment doesn't end at the prison gate. Ban the box. Clear the records.

title: Karl Data Narrative: Ban-the-box policies have been adopted in more than 35 state
author: MTCSTW Training Pack
text:
[Statistic: Ban-the-box policies have been adopted in more than 35 states]
[Source: National Employment Law Project (approximate)]

Give people a fair shot at an interview before judging their past. People who work are less likely to return to prison.

title: Karl Data Narrative: Clean slate laws automatically seal some old records in a gr
author: MTCSTW Training Pack
text:
[Statistic: Clean slate laws automatically seal some old records in a growing number of states]
[Source: Clean Slate Initiative]

Millions qualify for record clearing but never apply. Automatic sealing fixes paperwork as a barrier to a second chance.

title: Karl Data Narrative: Lobbying expenditures by the pharmaceutical and health produ
author: MTCSTW Training Pack
text:
[Statistic: Lobbying expenditures by the pharmaceutical and health products industry are among the highest of any sector]
[Source: OpenSecrets]

The drug industry spends more on lobbying than almost anyone. That's why your prices are high and reform is slow.

title: Karl Data Narrative: Fossil fuel interests have spent heavily on lobbying and ele
author: MTCSTW Training Pack
text:
[Statistic: Fossil fuel interests have spent heavily on lobbying and elections for decades]
[Source: OpenSecrets / InfluenceMap]

They bought delay. Every year of inaction was paid for. Follow the money to the burning planet.

title: Karl Data Narrative: Nearly half of U.S. households have no retirement account
author: MTCSTW Training Pack
text:
[Statistic: Nearly half of U.S. households have no retirement account]
[Source: Federal Reserve Survey of Consumer Finances 2022 (approximate)]

Retirement isn't 'work until you're dead' by accident. Pensions were cut and wages stagnated. Social Security is all millions have.

title: Karl Data Narrative: The richest 1% of Americans own about half of all stocks
author: MTCSTW Training Pack
text:
[Statistic: The richest 1% of Americans own about half of all stocks]
[Source: Federal Reserve Distributional Financial Accounts (approximate)]

When they say tax cuts on capital gains help 'investors,' they mean this group. Most families don't own enough stock to notice.

title: Karl Data Narrative: Inheritances account for a large share of wealth at the very
author: MTCSTW Training Pack
text:
[Statistic: Inheritances account for a large share of wealth at the very top]
[Source: Federal Reserve and academic research (approximate)]

Many fortunes weren't built. They were handed down. Meritocracy is a story the heirs like to tell.
